features.name: log_capital_total
features.description: Log-scaled total capital run length to compress heavy-tailed scale for distance computation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces extreme magnitude dominance in Euclidean distance from capital length features.

features.name: log_capital_longest
features.description: Log-scaled longest capital run length for robust distance scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Stabilizes neighborhood geometry by compressing extreme capital-run outliers.

features.name: log_capital_average
features.description: Log-scaled average capital run length for KNN distance robustness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses outlier-dominated capital averages so distances reflect relative magnitudes.

features.name: total_word_freq_sum
features.description: Sum of all word frequency features summarizing overall keyword density.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a global density coordinate that helps cluster similar messages by overall word activity.

features.name: total_char_freq_sum
features.description: Sum of all character-frequency features summarizing punctuation/special-character density.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds compact special-character signal that improves neighborhood geometry.

features.name: nonzero_word_count
features.description: Count of word-frequency features that are present (nonzero) in the row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Vocabulary breadth indicator that separates sparse and dense documents in KNN space.

features.name: char_to_word_ratio
features.description: Ratio of special-character density to word density indicating punctuation-heavy content.
features.expected_model_benefit: Scale-free style descriptor that improves distance separation between content types.

features.name: capital_burstiness
features.description: Ratio of longest capital run to average capital run; measures capitalization burstiness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures bursty caps usage common in promotional content for cleaner neighborhoods.

features.name: high_freq_word_indicator
features.description: Indicator that at least one prominent word feature exceeds a high threshold (z>3 of its training mean+std).
features.expected_model_benefit: Binary cluster flag highlighting messages with extreme key-word usage for KNN partitioning.

features.name: dist_to_origin_prototype
features.description: Euclidean-like log-scaled distance from a generic all-zero (empty-message) reference using compressed magnitudes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Unsupervised prototype distance gives a strong radial coordinate for neighborhood geometry.

features.name: shouting_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of how much a message exhibits 'shouting' style based on combined capitalization scale and burstiness; high values indicate strong shouting/promotional tone.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a stylistic axis that aligns messages of similar tone in distance space.

features.name: promotional_keyword_intensity
features.description: Semantic intensity of promotional/marketing keyword density inferred from the overall word-frequency profile; higher values reflect more aggressive promotional vocabulary.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a content-style coordinate that improves neighbor coherence beyond raw counts.
